input_messages.content: Hi there! I’m having trouble with my mobile data—it either stops working or is very slow, and I really need excellent internet speed on my phone. I don’t have access to Wi-Fi right now. Can you help me get this fixed?
Sure! My name is John Smith and my phone number is 555-123-2002. Let me know if you need any more information.
I’m having the issue with my own phone, which is the number 555-123-2002. That should be the line I’m using right now.

According to my phone’s status bar, the number I’m using is 555-123-2002. Could you double-check if this number is linked to one of the lines on my account? If you need me to check anything else on my device to confirm, just let me know!
I tried running a speed test on my phone, but it failed and said "No Connection." What should I do next?

Here’s what I see on my phone:

1. Airplane Mode is NOT turned on.
2. Mobile Data is enabled.
3. My SIM card is active and working.

Is there anything else you’d like me to check or try next?

My phone is currently connected to a 2G network with poor signal, and the network mode preference is set to "2G only." Mobile data is enabled, but data roaming is off. What should I do next to improve my data speed?
Yes, please go ahead and change my network mode preference to "4g_5g_preferred." I definitely want to get the best possible internet speed.

The network mode preference has been changed to "4G/5G preferred." My status bar now shows an excellent signal and 5G connectivity. What would you like me to do next? Should I try running another speed test?
I tried running the speed test again, but it still failed and says "No Connection," even though my status bar shows excellent 5G signal. What should I do next?

Data Saver mode is off, and there are no data restrictions enabled on my phone. Also, it looks like I don’t have a specific "Speed Test" app installed—I've been using the built-in speed test feature. Is there anything else I should check or try?
I checked my APN settings, and the current APN name is set to "internet" with the MMSC URL as "http://mms.carrier.com/mms/wapenc." Do these look correct, or should I try resetting them to default?
Yes, please guide me through resetting my APN settings to default. I’m ready to follow your instructions, and I’ll reboot my device afterward as you suggested.

I followed your instructions to reset the APN settings and rebooted my phone, but unfortunately, the speed test still fails and says "No Connection." Is there anything else we can try? I really need to get excellent internet speed on my phone.

Whenever the agent asks you about your device, always ground your responses on the results of tool calls.
